about_the_game:
After she was gone, I realized how weak I was... I never want to feel that again.

That promise manifested as metal and firepower. A single gun, infinite in its fury, became the answer to my weakness.

When a voice on the radio whispered of a safe base, the hunt was given a destination. But the world hasn't forgotten. The dead have evolved. They don't stumble in the dark; they hunt, they dodge, and they think. To reach my goal, I will have to become the monster they fear.

One Man. Driven by a promise.
One Gun. Infinite as his rage.
One Thousand Zombies. Smart enough to be a challenge, but not to survive you.

Features:

  • Enemies That Hunt, Not Wander: Forget brainless hordes. Face the undead that dodge your shots, surround you, and use the environment against you. Your brute force means nothing without tactics.

  • A World That Hides the Truth: Amidst the carnage, the mystery remains. Why do all survivors wear masks? What truly happened? The truth is scattered among the wreckage.

  • Absolute Power, Essential Control: Your weapon is a godlike power, but control is in your hands. Use your agility to stay one step ahead of enemies that adapt to your actions.

  • Tactical Destruction: The environment is more than destructible; it's your primary weapon. Create chokepoints, blast escape routes, and turn the world into a deadly trap for the intelligent horde.

The path to the safe base isn't about survival. It's about proving you will never be weak again.

Add One Man! One Gun! One Thousand Zombies! to your Wishlist now!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent violence, blood, and gore depicted in a pixel art style. Players use a firearm to engage in intense combat against large numbers of zombies and other human survivors.

The game also features mature themes, including a protagonist with a cynical and violent worldview, occasional strong language (swearing), and moments of psychological horror with unsettling, unkillable enemies. Player discretion is advised.```
